privacyNotice.title: Your Privacy Matters
privacyNotice.subtitle: 100% Client-Side Processing
privacyNotice.description: We care deeply about your data privacy. This application processes all your JSON data entirely in your browser.
privacyNotice.feature1Desc: Your JSON data is never sent to any server. Everything stays on your device.
privacyNotice.feature2Desc: We don't use analytics or tracking. Your activity remains completely private.
privacyNotice.feature3Desc: Once loaded, the app works offline. Your data never needs to leave your browser.

welcomePopup.title: Welcome to JSON Formatter
welcomePopup.subtitle: Discover what you can do
welcomePopup.newFeatureDesc: Advanced JWT support! Automatically detects pasted raw or quoted JWTs (including Bearer prefix) and decodes Header, Payload (with UTC timestamp conversions), Signature, and the full raw token at the bottom.
welcomePopup.newFeatureTry: Try it out → Paste any JWT token in the Editor!
welcomePopup.feature1Desc: Instantly format and beautify your JSON data with one click
welcomePopup.feature2Desc: Compress JSON by removing whitespace for production use
welcomePopup.feature3Desc: Navigate your JSON with an interactive, collapsible tree view
welcomePopup.feature4Desc: Generate class models in TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, Go, Rust
welcomePopup.feature5Desc: Partially format and recover content from broken or invalid JSON
welcomePopup.feature6Desc: Remove null values, default dates, zeros, empty arrays and convert .NET dates
welcomePopup.feature7Desc: Choose from 20 themes with dark and light mode support
welcomePopup.feature8Desc: Ctrl+Shift+F to format, Ctrl+S to download, and more
welcomePopup.feature9Desc: Available as Web, Windows and Linux desktop app with offline support
welcomePopup.feature10Desc: Instantly decodes pasted JWTs into Header, Payload, Signature, and Raw token JSON fields
